title: Easthaven
autoCompleteNotReady: Available once every card is face up
cannotDealEmptyColExists: Fill every empty column before dealing

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card can move to a foundation
frontendHint.moveToTableau: A card can move between tableau columns

tutorial.foundation: Build each suit up from Ace to King here. Complete all four to win.
tutorial.tableau: Seven tableau columns. Build down in alternating colors. Click/drag an ordered face-up run to move it. Only Kings go to an empty column.
tutorial.stock: The Deal button deals one face-up card to every column from the stock. You cannot deal while a column is empty.
tutorial.controls: Hint, give up, and undo controls.
